svg.text: AI CAN ASSIST. BUT WHO MAKES THE DECISION?
Inside TriageDesk — from patient arrival to human-approved triage.
Seven moments at the desk. The human stays in the loop.
A nurse welcomes the patient at the OPD desk.
The model structures language. Nothing more.
TEWS and SATS overrides, in code.
Every colour cites its rule. No match defers.
The clinician approves, edits, or dismisses.
The card moves only after a named approval.
Eleven nodes. One deterministic score. One human interrupt.
failure and deferral paths — never silent
THE RULES ENGINE CALCULATES THE PRIORITY.
Six components. No hidden services, no autonomous agents.
Does not compute TEWS or assign the colour.
Distinct from the Triage MCP server.
Hash-chained record: inputs, outputs, timestamp, approver.
Queue write only via commit_priority + a named approval.
Competition MVP · not clinically validated · synthetic data · Apache-2.0
